class SignalLock{
 constructor(random=Math.random){this.base=3.4+random()*3.0;this.phaseTarget=random()*Math.PI*2;this.ampTarget=.55+random()*.28;this.frequency=4;this.phase=0;this.amplitude=.65;this.elapsed=0;this.duration=45;this.progress=0;this.state='playing';}
 target(){return {frequency:this.base+Math.sin(this.elapsed*.32)*.025,phase:this.phaseTarget+Math.sin(this.elapsed*.24)*.025,amplitude:this.ampTarget};}
 error(){const t=this.target();return {frequency:Math.abs(t.frequency-this.frequency),phase:Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(t.phase-this.phase),Math.cos(t.phase-this.phase))),amplitude:Math.abs(t.amplitude-this.amplitude)};}
 step(dt){if(this.state!=='playing')return;this.elapsed+=dt;const e=this.error(),ok=e.frequency<.12&&e.phase<.15&&e.amplitude<.075;this.progress=clamp(this.progress+dt*(ok?1:-.7),0,2.5);if(this.progress>=2.5)this.state='decoded';else if(this.elapsed>=this.duration)this.state='expired';}
}
window.KBQuickGames={FreeKick,SignalLock};})();

 const dirs=[[-1,0,1,4],[0,1,2,8],[1,0,4,1],[0,-1,8,2]];
 function rotate(mask,n=1){for(let i=0;i<n%4;i++)mask=((mask<<1)&15)|(mask>>3);return mask;}
 function circuitBoard(seed,difficulty,phase){const n=3+difficulty,r=random((seed+phase*7919)>>>0),last=n*n-1,path=[0],seen=new Set([0]);
  function walk(i){if(i===last)return true;const row=Math.floor(i/n),col=i%n,next=[];for(const [dr,dc]of dirs){const rr=row+dr,cc=col+dc;if(rr>=0&&rr<n&&cc>=0&&cc<n&&!seen.has(rr*n+cc))next.push(rr*n+cc);}for(let k=next.length-1;k>0;k--){const j=Math.floor(r()*(k+1));[next[k],next[j]]=[next[j],next[k]];}for(const q of next){seen.add(q);path.push(q);if(walk(q))return true;path.pop();seen.delete(q);}return false;}

(() => {
  'use strict';
  const KEY = 'kb_director_v1', MAX_BYTES = 160000;
  const own = (o, k) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, k);
  const plain = o => o !== null && typeof o === 'object' && !Array.isArray(o) &&
    (Object.getPrototypeOf(o) === Object.prototype || Object.getPrototypeOf(o) === null);
  const idOK = s => typeof s === 'string' && /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{0,79}$/.test(s) &&
    !['__proto__', 'prototype', 'constructor'].includes(s);
  const finite = (n, max = 1e9) => Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= max;
  const copy = o => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
  const assert = (ok, message) => { if (!ok) throw Error(message); };
  function jsonSafe(v, depth = 0) {
    assert(depth <= 16, 'Snimak ima previše nivoa.');
    if (v === null || typeof v === 'boolean') return;
    if (typeof v === 'number') { assert(Number.isFinite(v), 'Neispravan broj u snimku.'); return; }
    if (typeof v === 'string') { assert(v.length <= 4096, 'Tekst u snimku je predugačak.'); return; }
    assert(Array.isArray(v) || plain(v), 'Snimak mora sadržati samo JSON podatke.');
    assert(Object.keys(v).length <= 1024, 'Previše stavki u snimku.');
    Object.keys(v).forEach(k => {
      assert(!['__proto__', 'prototype', 'constructor'].includes(k), 'Nedozvoljen ključ u snimku.');
      jsonSafe(v[k], depth + 1);
    });
  }
  function mapCheck(v, max, test) {
    assert(plain(v) && Object.keys(v).length <= max, 'Neispravna kolekcija u snimku.');
    Object.keys(v).forEach(k => assert(idOK(k) && test(v[k], k), 'Neispravna stavka: ' + k));
  }
  function flagsCheck(v) {
    mapCheck(v, 192, x => typeof x === 'boolean' || x === null ||
      typeof x === 'string' && x.length <= 160 || typeof x === 'number' && Number.isFinite(x) && Math.abs(x) <= 1e6);
  }
  function classicCheck(v) {
    if (v === null) return;
    assert(plain(v) && v.version === 1, 'Nepoznat 2D napredak.');
    assert(Array.isArray(v.items) && v.items.length === 4 && v.items.every(x => typeof x === 'boolean'), 'Neispravna torba.');
    assert(Array.isArray(v.zones) && v.zones.length <= 10 && new Set(v.zones).size === v.zones.length &&
      v.zones.every(x => Number.isInteger(x) && x >= 0 && x < 10), 'Neispravne 2D zone.');
    ['suppliesDone', 'exploreDone', 'suppliesStarted', 'exploreStarted', 'raceRunning'].forEach(k =>
      assert(typeof v[k] === 'boolean', 'Neispravno 2D stanje.'));
    assert(finite(v.best, 86400) && finite(v.raceElapsed, 86400) && finite(v.raceCooldown, 20), 'Neispravno vreme trke.');
  }
  function fresh(now) {
    return {kind: 'kb-mission-director', version: 1, revision: 0, updatedAt: now,
      profile: {awards: {}, unlocks: {}, records: {}},
      campaign: {active: null, missions: {}, flags: {}, legacy: {classic: null, beta: null}, dossiers: [], journal: []},
      migration: {version: 1, sources: []}};
  }
  function validate(v) {
    jsonSafe(v);
    assert(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(v)).length <= MAX_BYTES, 'Director snimak je prevelik.');
    assert(plain(v) && v.kind === 'kb-mission-director' && v.version === 1, 'Nepoznata verzija Director snimka.');
    assert(Number.isSafeInteger(v.revision) && finite(v.revision, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) && finite(v.updatedAt, 9e15), 'Neispravna verzija izmene.');
    assert(plain(v.profile) && plain(v.campaign), 'Nedostaje stanje misija.');
    mapCheck(v.profile.awards, 256, n => finite(n, 9e15));
    mapCheck(v.profile.unlocks, 256, x => x === true);
    mapCheck(v.profile.records, 256, r => plain(r) && finite(r.score, 100) && finite(r.elapsed, 86400 * 365) &&
      Number.isInteger(r.medal) && r.medal >= 0 && r.medal <= 3 && finite(r.at, 9e15));
    flagsCheck(v.campaign.flags);
    if(v.campaign.modules!==undefined) mapCheck(v.campaign.modules,8,(value,id)=>{
      const api=id==='story.b1'?window.KBB1Games:id==='story.b2'?window.KBB2Games:null;
      assert(api,'Nepoznat modul snimka.');api.validateCheckpoint(value);return true;
    });
    mapCheck(v.campaign.missions, 128, m => {
      assert(plain(m) && ['observed', 'active', 'paused', 'completed', 'failed'].includes(m.status), 'Nepoznat status misije.');
      assert(Number.isInteger(m.stage) && finite(m.stage, 63) && Number.isInteger(m.definitionVersion) && finite(m.definitionVersion, 999), 'Neispravna faza misije.');
      assert(finite(m.elapsed, 86400 * 365) && Number.isInteger(m.failures) && finite(m.failures, 100000), 'Neispravna statistika misije.');
      mapCheck(m.counts, 64, n => finite(n, 100000));
      mapCheck(m.seen, 64, a => Array.isArray(a) && a.length <= 256 && new Set(a).size === a.length && a.every(idOK));
      mapCheck(m.choices, 32, idOK);
      return true;
    });
    for (const d of legacyDefinitions) {
      const m = v.campaign.missions[d.id];
      if (m) assert(m.definitionVersion === 1 && m.stage === 0 &&
        Object.keys(m.counts).every(k => k === 'progress' && m.counts[k] <= d.stages[0].goals[0].target) &&
        Object.keys(m.seen).length === 0 && Object.keys(m.choices).length === 0 &&
        ['observed', 'completed'].includes(m.status), 'Neispravan napredak stare misije.');
    }
    const active = v.campaign.active;
    assert(active === null || idOK(active) && own(v.campaign.missions, active) &&
      ['active', 'paused'].includes(v.campaign.missions[active].status), 'Aktivna misija nedostaje.');
    Object.keys(v.campaign.missions).forEach(k => {
      if (['active', 'paused'].includes(v.campaign.missions[k].status)) assert(k === active, 'Više aktivnih misija.');
    });
    assert(plain(v.campaign.legacy), 'Nedostaje veza sa starim snimkom.');
    classicCheck(v.campaign.legacy.classic);
    const beta = v.campaign.legacy.beta;
    if (beta !== null) {
      assert(plain(beta) && Number.isInteger(beta.chapter) && beta.chapter >= 0 && beta.chapter <= 2 &&
        Number.isInteger(beta.step) && beta.step >= 0 && beta.step <= [8, 6, 3][beta.chapter] && typeof beta.complete === 'boolean', 'Neispravna stara priča.');
    }
    assert(Array.isArray(v.campaign.dossiers) && v.campaign.dossiers.length <= 128, 'Previše dosijea.');
    const dossierIds = new Set();
    v.campaign.dossiers.forEach(d => {
      assert(plain(d) && idOK(d.id) && !dossierIds.has(d.id) && typeof d.title === 'string' && d.title.length <= 180 &&
        typeof d.body === 'string' && d.body.length <= 1200, 'Neispravan dosije.'); dossierIds.add(d.id);
    });
    assert(Array.isArray(v.campaign.journal) && v.campaign.journal.length <= 128, 'Dnevnik je prevelik.');
    v.campaign.journal.forEach(j => assert(plain(j) && finite(j.at, 9e15) && typeof j.text === 'string' && j.text.length <= 240, 'Neispravan dnevnik.'));
    assert(plain(v.migration) && v.migration.version === 1 && Array.isArray(v.migration.sources) &&
      v.migration.sources.length <= 32 && v.migration.sources.every(idOK), 'Neispravna migracija.');
    return copy(v);
  }
  const legacyDefinitions = [
    ['legacy.2d.supplies', 'Zalihe za ekipu', '2d', 4],
    ['legacy.2d.explore', 'Istraživač brda', '2d', 10],
    ['legacy.2d.descent', 'Spust sa vrha', '2d', 1],
    ['legacy.3d.park', 'Signal u trouglastom parkiću', '3d', 8],
    ['legacy.3d.power', 'Morzeov napon u Durmitorskoj', '3d', 6],
    ['legacy.3d.station', 'Frekvencija sa uklete meteo stanice', '3d', 3]
  ].map(([id, title, engine, target]) => ({id, title, engine, version: 1, legacy: true,
    prerequisites: [], conditions: {}, rewards: [], stages: [{id: 'main', goals: [{id: 'progress', event: 'legacy', target}]}]}));

  function definitionCheck(input) {
    jsonSafe(input); const d = copy(input);
    assert(idOK(d.id) && typeof d.title === 'string' && d.title.length <= 180 && ['2d', '3d'].includes(d.engine), 'Neispravna definicija misije.');
    assert(Number.isInteger(d.version) && d.version >= 1 && d.version < 1000, 'Nedostaje verzija definicije.');
    d.legacy = d.legacy === true; d.prerequisites = d.prerequisites || []; d.conditions = d.conditions || {}; d.rewards = d.rewards || [];
    if(d.initialFlags) flagsCheck(d.initialFlags);
    assert(Array.isArray(d.prerequisites) && d.prerequisites.length <= 32 && d.prerequisites.every(idOK), 'Neispravni preduslovi.');
    assert(Array.isArray(d.rewards) && d.rewards.length <= 16 && d.rewards.every(idOK), 'Neispravne nagrade.');
    assert(plain(d.conditions), 'Neispravni uslovi sveta.');
    ['time', 'season', 'weather'].forEach(k => {
      if (own(d.conditions, k)) assert(Array.isArray(d.conditions[k]) && d.conditions[k].length > 0 &&
        d.conditions[k].every(x => typeof x === 'string' && x.length < 40), 'Neispravan uslov sveta.');
    });
    if (d.conditions.flags) flagsCheck(d.conditions.flags);
    assert(Array.isArray(d.stages) && d.stages.length > 0 && d.stages.length <= 64, 'Nedostaju faze misije.');
    const stages = new Set(), goalIds = new Set(), choiceIds = new Set();
    d.stages.forEach(s => {
      assert(idOK(s.id) && !stages.has(s.id), 'Ponovljena faza.'); stages.add(s.id);
      assert(Array.isArray(s.goals) && s.goals.length > 0 && s.goals.length <= 16, 'Nedostaju ciljevi faze.');
      s.goals.forEach(g => {
        assert(idOK(g.id) && !goalIds.has(g.id) && idOK(g.event) && Number.isInteger(g.target) && g.target > 0 && g.target <= 256, 'Neispravan cilj.');
        goalIds.add(g.id); assert(g.unique === undefined || typeof g.unique === 'boolean', 'Neispravan način brojanja.');
        if (g.match !== undefined) flagsCheck(g.match);
      });
      if (s.choice) {
        const ch = s.choice; assert(idOK(ch.id) && !choiceIds.has(ch.id), 'Neispravan izbor.'); choiceIds.add(ch.id);
        assert(Array.isArray(ch.options) && ch.options.length >= 2 && ch.options.length <= 6, 'Izbor mora imati opcije.');
        const opts = new Set(); ch.options.forEach(o => {
          assert(idOK(o.id) && !opts.has(o.id), 'Ponovljena opcija.'); opts.add(o.id);
          flagsCheck(o.flags || {}); if (o.next !== undefined) assert(idOK(o.next), 'Neispravan cilj grananja.');
        });
      }
    });
    assert(goalIds.size <= 64, 'Previše ciljeva u misiji.');
    d.stages.forEach((s, i) => {
      const checkNext = next => assert(next === 'complete' || d.stages.findIndex(x => x.id === next) > i, 'Grana mora voditi unapred.');
      if (s.next !== undefined) checkNext(s.next);
      if (s.choice) s.choice.options.forEach(o => { if (o.next !== undefined) checkNext(o.next); });
      if (s.failure !== undefined) { assert(plain(s.failure) && idOK(s.failure.next), 'Neispravna posledica neuspeha.'); checkNext(s.failure.next); flagsCheck(s.failure.flags || {}); }
    });
    return d;
  }

  function create(options = {}) {
    const now = options.now || Date.now, store = options.storage || null, key = options.key || KEY;
    const definitions = new Map(), diagnostics = [], listeners = new Set();
    let state = fresh(now()), dirty = false, blocked = false, durable = false, elapsedSinceFlush = 0;
    function note(code, error) {
      if (!diagnostics.some(d => d.code === code)) {
        diagnostics.push({code, message: String(error.message || error).slice(0, 180)});
        if (diagnostics.length > 24) diagnostics.shift();
      }
    }
    function notify() { for (const fn of listeners) { try { fn(); } catch (e) { note('listener', e); } } }
    function read(k) { try { return store ? store.getItem(k) : null; } catch (e) { note('read', e); return null; } }
    function readJSON(k) { try { return JSON.parse(read(k)); } catch (e) { note('legacy-' + k, e); return null; } }
    function flush() {
      if (blocked) return false;
      if (!dirty) return durable;
      try {
        validate(state); assert(store, 'Trajno čuvanje nije dostupno.');
        state.updatedAt = now();
        store.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(state)); durable = true; dirty = false; elapsedSinceFlush = 0; return true;
      } catch (e) { durable = false; note('save', e); return false; }
    }
    function commit(next, persist = true) {
      if (blocked) return false;
      next.revision = state.revision + 1; next.updatedAt = now(); validate(next);
      state = next; dirty = true; if (persist) flush(); notify(); return true;
    }
    function journal(s, text) {
      s.campaign.journal.push({at: now(), text: text.slice(0, 240)});
      if (s.campaign.journal.length > 128) s.campaign.journal.shift();
    }
    function record(d, status = 'active') {
      return {definitionVersion: d.version, status, stage: 0, counts: {}, seen: {}, choices: {}, elapsed: 0, failures: 0};
    }
    function complete(s, d, m, score = null, recordKey = null) {
      const first = !own(s.profile.awards, d.id); m.status = 'completed';
      if (s.campaign.active === d.id) s.campaign.active = null;
      if (first) {
        s.profile.awards[d.id] = now(); for (const reward of d.rewards) s.profile.unlocks[reward] = true;
        journal(s, 'Završeno: ' + d.title);
      }
      if (score !== null) {
        const medal = score >= 95 ? 3 : score >= 80 ? 2 : score >= 60 ? 1 : 0;
        const k = recordKey || d.id, prev = s.profile.records[k];
        if (!prev || score > prev.score || score === prev.score && m.elapsed < prev.elapsed)
          s.profile.records[k] = {score, medal, elapsed: m.elapsed, at: now()};
      }
    }
    function observe(s, id, progress, done) {
      const d = definitions.get(id), m = s.campaign.missions[id] || record(d, 'observed');
      m.counts.progress = Math.max(m.counts.progress || 0, Math.min(d.stages[0].goals[0].target, progress));
      s.campaign.missions[id] = m;
      if (done && m.status !== 'completed') complete(s, d, m);
    }
    function applyClassic(s, v) {
      classicCheck(v); s.campaign.legacy.classic = copy(v);
      observe(s, 'legacy.2d.supplies', v.items.filter(Boolean).length, v.suppliesDone);
      observe(s, 'legacy.2d.explore', v.zones.length, v.exploreDone);
      observe(s, 'legacy.2d.descent', v.best > 0 ? 1 : 0, v.best > 0);
      if (v.best > 0) {
        const k = 'legacy.2d.descent', prev = s.profile.records[k];
        if (!prev || v.best < prev.elapsed) s.profile.records[k] = {score: 0, medal: 0, elapsed: v.best, at: now()};
      }
    }
    function applyBeta(s, v) {
      if (!v || !v.on && !v.complete) return;
      const chapter = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, v.chapter | 0)), size = [8, 6, 3];
      const step = Math.max(0, Math.min(size[chapter], v.step | 0));
      s.campaign.legacy.beta = {chapter, step, complete: !!v.complete};
      if (v.flags) { flagsCheck(v.flags); Object.assign(s.campaign.flags, copy(v.flags)); }
      const ids = ['legacy.3d.park', 'legacy.3d.power', 'legacy.3d.station'];
      ids.forEach((id, i) => observe(s, id, v.complete || i < chapter ? size[i] : i === chapter ? step : 0,
        !!v.complete || i < chapter));
    }
    function fromLegacy(values) {
      const get = k => values ? (own(values, k) ? (() => { try { return JSON.parse(values[k]); } catch (_) { return null; } })() : null) : readJSON(k);
      const s = fresh(now()), sources = [];
      const supplies = get('kb_mis1'), zones = get('kb_mis2'), explore = get('kb_mis2d'), best = get('kb_m3best');
      const v = {version: 1, items: [false, false, false, false], zones: Array.isArray(zones) ? [...new Set(zones.filter(i => Number.isInteger(i) && i >= 0 && i < 10))] : [],
        suppliesDone: supplies === 1 || supplies === true, exploreDone: explore === 1 || explore === true,
        suppliesStarted: false, exploreStarted: false, raceRunning: false, raceElapsed: 0, raceCooldown: 0,
        best: finite(best, 86400) && best > 0 ? best : 0};
      if (v.suppliesDone) v.items.fill(true);
      if (supplies !== null || zones !== null || explore !== null || best !== null) {
        applyClassic(s, v); sources.push('classic');
      }
      const b = get('kb_cinema_story_v5'), done = get('kb_cinema_complete_v5');
      if (b && b.version === 5 && Number.isInteger(b.chapter) && b.chapter >= 0 && b.chapter <= 2 && Number.isInteger(b.step) && b.step >= 0 && b.step <= 100 &&
        Number.isInteger(b.active) && b.active >= 0 && b.active <= 2 && Array.isArray(b.actors) && b.actors.length === 3 &&
        b.actors.every(a => a && ['x', 'z', 'yaw'].every(k => Number.isFinite(a[k])))) {
        const flags = {}; if (plain(b.flags)) Object.keys(b.flags).slice(0, 192).forEach(k => {
          if (idOK(k) && (typeof b.flags[k] === 'boolean' || typeof b.flags[k] === 'string' && b.flags[k].length <= 160 || typeof b.flags[k] === 'number' && Number.isFinite(b.flags[k]) && Math.abs(b.flags[k]) <= 1e6)) flags[k] = b.flags[k];
        });
        applyBeta(s, {on: true, chapter: b.chapter, step: Math.min(b.step, [7, 5, 2][b.chapter]), flags}); sources.push('cinema-v5');
      } else if (done === true || done === 1) { applyBeta(s, {complete: true, chapter: 2, step: 3}); sources.push('cinema-complete-v5'); }
      const ds = get('kb_cinema_dossiers_v5');
      if (Array.isArray(ds)) for (const d of ds.slice(0, 128)) {
        if (d && idOK(d.id) && typeof d.title === 'string' && typeof d.body === 'string' && !s.campaign.dossiers.some(x => x.id === d.id))
          s.campaign.dossiers.push({id: d.id, title: d.title.slice(0, 180), body: d.body.slice(0, 1200)});
      }
      s.migration.sources = sources; return s;
    }
    function register(input) {
      const d = definitionCheck(input); assert(!definitions.has(d.id), 'Misija već postoji: ' + d.id);
      const m = state.campaign.missions[d.id];
      if (m) {
        assert(m.definitionVersion === d.version, 'Potrebna je migracija definicije: ' + d.id);
        assert(m.stage < d.stages.length, 'Sačuvana faza ne postoji.');
        const goals = new Map(d.stages.flatMap(s => s.goals.map(g => [g.id, g])));
        Object.keys(m.counts).forEach(k => assert(goals.has(k) && m.counts[k] <= goals.get(k).target, 'Neispravan napredak cilja.'));
      }
      definitions.set(d.id, d); return true;
    }
    function available(id, env = {}) {
      const d = definitions.get(id); if (!d) return {ok: false, reason: 'Sadržaj još nije instaliran.'};
      if (d.legacy) return {ok: false, reason: 'Pokreće se kroz postojeću igru.'};
      for (const req of d.prerequisites) if (state.campaign.missions[req]?.status !== 'completed' && !own(state.profile.awards, req))
        return {ok: false, reason: 'Prvo završi prethodni zadatak.'};
      for (const k of ['time', 'season', 'weather']) if (d.conditions[k] && !d.conditions[k].includes(env[k]))
        return {ok: false, reason: 'Potrebni su drugi uslovi u kraju.'};
      for (const k of Object.keys(d.conditions.flags || {})) if (state.campaign.flags[k] !== d.conditions.flags[k])
        return {ok: false, reason: 'Nedostaje prethodna odluka.'};
      return {ok: true, reason: ''};
    }
    function start(id, env = {}) {
      if (blocked || state.campaign.active) return false;
      if (!available(id, env).ok) return false;
      const next = copy(state), d = definitions.get(id); next.campaign.active = id;
      next.campaign.missions[id] = record(d); Object.assign(next.campaign.flags,d.initialFlags||{}); journal(next, 'Početak: ' + d.title); return commit(next);
    }
    function ready(d, m) { return d.stages[m.stage].goals.every(g => (m.counts[g.id] || 0) >= g.target); }
    function advance(next, d, m, dest, score) {
      const stage = d.stages[m.stage];
      const target = dest === undefined ? stage.next : dest;
      if (target === 'complete' || target === undefined && m.stage === d.stages.length - 1) {
        complete(next, d, m, score); return;
      }
      m.stage = target === undefined ? m.stage + 1 : d.stages.findIndex(s => s.id === target);
      journal(next, 'Sledeći korak: ' + d.title);
    }
    function signal(event, data = {}) {
      if (blocked || !idOK(event) || !plain(data)) return false;
      const id = state.campaign.active, d = definitions.get(id), current = state.campaign.missions[id];
      if (!d || current.status !== 'active') return false;
      const next = copy(state), m = next.campaign.missions[id]; let changed = false;
      for (const g of d.stages[m.stage].goals) {
        if (g.event !== event || Object.keys(g.match || {}).some(k => data[k] !== g.match[k])) continue;
        if (g.unique) {
          if (!idOK(data.id)) continue;
          const seen = m.seen[g.id] || (m.seen[g.id] = []);
          if (seen.includes(data.id) || seen.length >= g.target) continue;
          seen.push(data.id); m.counts[g.id] = seen.length; changed = true;
        } else if ((m.counts[g.id] || 0) < g.target) { m.counts[g.id] = (m.counts[g.id] || 0) + 1; changed = true; }
      }
      if (!changed) return false;
      if (ready(d, m) && !d.stages[m.stage].choice) advance(next, d, m, undefined, finite(data.score, 100) ? data.score : null);
      return commit(next);
    }
    function choose(choiceId, optionId) {
      const id = state.campaign.active, d = definitions.get(id), m = state.campaign.missions[id];
      if (blocked || !d || m.status !== 'active' || !ready(d, m)) return false;
      const ch = d.stages[m.stage].choice, option = ch && ch.options.find(o => o.id === optionId);
      if (!ch || ch.id !== choiceId || !option || own(m.choices, choiceId)) return false;
      const next = copy(state), nm = next.campaign.missions[id]; nm.choices[choiceId] = optionId;
      Object.assign(next.campaign.flags, option.flags || {});
      journal(next, 'Odluka: ' + (option.label || optionId)); advance(next, d, nm, option.next, null); return commit(next);
    }
    function fail(reason = 'Pokušaj je prekinut.') {
      const id = state.campaign.active, d = definitions.get(id), m = state.campaign.missions[id];
      if (blocked || !d || m.status !== 'active') return false;
      const next = copy(state), nm = next.campaign.missions[id], failure = d.stages[nm.stage].failure;
      nm.failures++; journal(next, String(reason).slice(0, 200));
      if (failure) { Object.assign(next.campaign.flags, failure.flags || {}); advance(next, d, nm, failure.next, null); }
      else { nm.status = 'paused'; }
      return commit(next);
    }
    function pause() {
      const id = state.campaign.active; if (!id || state.campaign.missions[id].status !== 'active') return false;
      const next = copy(state); next.campaign.missions[id].status = 'paused'; return commit(next);
    }
    function resume() {
      const id = state.campaign.active; if (!id || !definitions.has(id) || state.campaign.missions[id].status !== 'paused') return false;
      const next = copy(state); next.campaign.missions[id].status = 'active'; return commit(next);
    }
    function tick(dt, env = {}) {
      if (blocked || !Number.isFinite(dt) || dt <= 0 || dt > .25 || env.paused) return;
      const id = state.campaign.active, d = definitions.get(id), m = state.campaign.missions[id];
      if (d && d.engine === env.engine && m.status === 'active') { m.elapsed = Math.min(86400 * 365, m.elapsed + dt); dirty = true; }
      elapsedSinceFlush += dt; if (dirty && elapsedSinceFlush >= 5) flush();
    }
    function restore(input, mergeProfile = false) {
      const next = validate(input);
      for (const [id, d] of definitions) {
        const m = next.campaign.missions[id]; if (!m) continue;
        assert(m.definitionVersion === d.version && m.stage < d.stages.length, 'Nekompatibilna faza misije.');
        const goals = new Map(d.stages.flatMap(s => s.goals.map(g => [g.id, g])));
        Object.keys(m.counts).forEach(k => assert(goals.has(k) && m.counts[k] <= goals.get(k).target, 'Neispravan cilj u snimku.'));
      }
      if (mergeProfile) {
        Object.assign(next.profile.awards, state.profile.awards); Object.assign(next.profile.unlocks, state.profile.unlocks);
        for (const [k, r] of Object.entries(state.profile.records)) {
          const n = next.profile.records[k];
          if (!n || r.score > n.score || r.score === n.score && r.elapsed < n.elapsed) next.profile.records[k] = copy(r);
        }
      }
      blocked = false; return commit(next);
    }
    function load() {
      const raw = read(key);
      if (raw !== null) {
        try { state = validate(JSON.parse(raw)); dirty = false; blocked = false; durable = true; }
        catch (e) { blocked = true; durable = false; note('load-protected', e); }
      } else { blocked = false; state = fromLegacy(); dirty = true; flush(); }
    }
    legacyDefinitions.forEach(register); load();
    function setModule(id,data,persist=false) {
      if(blocked)return false;const api=id==='story.b1'?window.KBB1Games:id==='story.b2'?window.KBB2Games:null;assert(api,'Nepoznat modul.');
      const value=api.validateCheckpoint(data),next=copy(state);
      next.campaign.modules=next.campaign.modules||{};next.campaign.modules[id]=value;return commit(next,persist);
    }
    function recordGame(kind,difficulty,score,elapsed) {
      if(blocked)return false;assert(['radio','tones','photo','circuit'].includes(kind)&&Number.isInteger(difficulty)&&difficulty>=0&&difficulty<=2&&finite(score,100)&&finite(elapsed,600),'Neispravan rezultat.');
      const next=copy(state),id='game.'+kind+'.'+difficulty,old=next.profile.records[id];
      if(old&&(old.score>score||old.score===score&&old.elapsed<=elapsed))return true;
      next.profile.records[id]={score,elapsed,medal:score>=95?3:score>=80?2:score>=60?1:0,at:now()};return commit(next);
    }
    return Object.freeze({version: '1.2.0-B2', key, register, available, start, signal, choose, fail, pause, resume, tick, flush,setModule,recordGame,
      module:id=>copy(state.campaign.modules?.[id]||null),
      serialize: () => copy(state), validate, restore,
      get catalog() { return [...definitions.values()].map(copy); },
      get status() { return {durable, dirty, blocked, active: state.campaign.active, revision: state.revision, diagnostics: copy(diagnostics)}; },
      subscribe(fn) { assert(typeof fn === 'function', 'Listener mora biti funkcija.'); listeners.add(fn); return () => listeners.delete(fn); },
      report: note,
      observeClassic(v) {
        if (blocked) return false; classicCheck(v);
        // Vreme trke se čuva uz izričito snimanje; ne pišemo skladište svakim frejmom.
        if (JSON.stringify(state.campaign.legacy.classic) === JSON.stringify(v)) return true;
        const next = copy(state); applyClassic(next, v); return commit(next, false);
      },
      observeBeta(v) {
        if (blocked || !v || !v.on && !v.complete) return false;
        const before = JSON.stringify([state.campaign.legacy.beta, state.campaign.flags]);
        const next = copy(state); applyBeta(next, v);
        if (before === JSON.stringify([next.campaign.legacy.beta, next.campaign.flags])) return true;
        return commit(next);
      },
      beginBeta(flags) {
        if (blocked) return false;
        flagsCheck(flags || {});
        const next = copy(state);
        const retained={};for(const k of Object.keys(next.campaign.flags))if(k.startsWith('b1')||k.startsWith('b2')||k==='zapisPodeljen')retained[k]=next.campaign.flags[k];
        next.campaign.flags = {...retained,...copy(flags || {})};
        next.campaign.legacy.beta = null;
        for (const id of ['legacy.3d.park','legacy.3d.power','legacy.3d.station']) delete next.campaign.missions[id];
        return commit(next);
      },
      addDossier(d) {
        if (blocked || !d || !idOK(d.id) || typeof d.title !== 'string' || typeof d.body !== 'string') return false;
        if (state.campaign.dossiers.some(x => x.id === d.id)) return true;
        const next = copy(state); if (next.campaign.dossiers.length >= 128) return false;
        next.campaign.dossiers.push({id: d.id, title: d.title.slice(0, 180), body: d.body.slice(0, 1200)}); return commit(next);
      },
      classicSnapshot: () => copy(state.campaign.legacy.classic),
      migrated: values => validate(fromLegacy(values)),
      reload: load
    });
  }
  let storage = null; try { storage = window.localStorage; } catch (_) {}
  const director = create({storage});
  window.KBMissionDirector = Object.freeze({create, validate, key: KEY, instance: director});
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-director-adapters-a1">
/* A1 adapteri: izričite kuke u originalnom kodu, bez prepisivanja prototipova. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const root = window.KBMissionDirector, D = root.instance, hosts = new Map();
  function safe(fn, fallback = null) {
    try { return fn(D); } catch (e) { D.report('adapter', e); return fallback; }
  }
  function validateNative(data, mode) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) throw Error('Nedostaje snimak igre.');
    if (mode === 'story') {
      if (data.version !== 5 || !Number.isInteger(data.chapter) || data.chapter < 0 || data.chapter > 2 ||
        !Number.isInteger(data.step) || data.step < 0 || data.step > 100 || !Number.isInteger(data.active) ||
        data.active < 0 || data.active > 2 || !Array.isArray(data.actors) || data.actors.length !== 3 ||
        data.actors.some(a => !a || !['x', 'z', 'yaw'].every(k => Number.isFinite(a[k])))) throw Error('Neispravan snimak priče.');
    } else if (mode === 'free') {
      if (!Number.isFinite(data.x) || !Number.isFinite(data.z)) throw Error('Neispravan snimak slobodne igre.');
    } else if (mode === 'classic') {
      if (data.v !== 2 || !Number.isFinite(data.at) || !Number.isFinite(data.x) || data.x < 0 || data.x > 6400 ||
        !Number.isFinite(data.y) || data.y < 0 || data.y > 4600) throw Error('Neispravan 2D snimak.');
    } else throw Error('Nepoznat režim snimka.');
    if (data.kbDirector !== undefined) {
      const s = root.validate(data.kbDirector), b = s.campaign.legacy.beta;
      if (mode === 'story' && (!b || b.complete || b.chapter !== data.chapter || b.step !== data.step))
        throw Error('Pozicija i Director priča nisu iz istog trenutka.');
    }
    return true;
  }
  function nativeRestore(data, mode) {
    validateNative(data, mode);
    if (data.kbDirector !== undefined) return D.restore(data.kbDirector, true);
    if (mode === 'story') return D.beginBeta(data.flags || {});
    return true;
  }
  function transaction(entries, after) {
    const before = entries.map(([k]) => [k, localStorage.getItem(k)]);
    try {
      for (const [k, value] of entries) localStorage.setItem(k, value);
      if (after) after();
    } catch (e) {
      let rollback = true;
      for (const [k, value] of before) try { if (value === null) localStorage.removeItem(k); else localStorage.setItem(k, value); }
      catch (_) { rollback = false; }
      D.reload();
      throw Error(rollback ? 'Snimak nije učitan. Prethodni podaci su vraćeni.' : 'Čuvanje je prekinuto. Sačuvaj rezervnu kopiju.');
    }
  }
  const adapters = Object.freeze({safe, validateNative, nativeRestore,
    connect(engine, host) {
      if (!['2d', '3d'].includes(engine) || !host || typeof host !== 'object') throw Error('Neispravan adapter pogona.');
      if (hosts.has(engine)) throw Error('Adapter je već povezan.'); hosts.set(engine, Object.freeze(host));
    },
    host: engine => hosts.get(engine) || null,
    capture() { if (D.status.blocked) return undefined; D.flush(); return D.serialize(); },
    prepareImport(values) {
      const next = Object.assign({}, values);
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, root.key)) root.validate(JSON.parse(next[root.key]));
      else next[root.key] = JSON.stringify(D.migrated(next));
      return next;
    },
    loadSlot(slot) {
      window.KBStoryExtensions?.suspend();
      const keys = {story: 'kb_cinema_story_v5', free: 'kb_real_free_v1'};
      if (!slot || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(keys, slot.mode) || slot.key !== keys[slot.mode]) throw Error('Neispravan slot.');
      validateNative(slot.data, slot.mode);
      if (D.status.dirty && !D.flush()) throw Error('Prvo sačuvaj trenutni napredak. Skladište nije dostupno.');
      const previous = D.serialize();
      let snapshot = slot.data.kbDirector;
      if (!snapshot) {
        snapshot = D.migrated({[slot.key]: JSON.stringify(slot.data)});
        snapshot.campaign.legacy.classic = previous.campaign.legacy.classic;
        for (const id of ['legacy.2d.supplies', 'legacy.2d.explore', 'legacy.2d.descent'])
          if (previous.campaign.missions[id]) snapshot.campaign.missions[id] = previous.campaign.missions[id];
      }
      const oldRaw = localStorage.getItem(root.key);
      // restore spaja trajna otključavanja; privremeni tok priče ostaje vezan za slot.
      D.restore(snapshot, true);
      if (!D.status.durable) { D.reload(); throw Error('Nema mesta za napredak misija.'); }
      const merged = D.serialize(), data = Object.assign({}, slot.data, {kbDirector: merged});
      if (!slot.data.kbDirector && slot.mode === 'story') data.step = Math.min(data.step, [7, 5, 2][data.chapter]);
      try {
        transaction([[slot.key, JSON.stringify(data)]], () => {
          if (!window.KBBeta3D || window.KBBeta3D.loadSaved(slot.mode) === false) throw Error('Pogon nije dostupan.');
        });
      } catch (e) {
        if (oldRaw === null) localStorage.removeItem(root.key); else localStorage.setItem(root.key, oldRaw);
        D.reload(); throw e;
      }
      return true;
    }
  });
  window.KBMissionDirector = Object.freeze({create: root.create, validate: root.validate, key: root.key, instance: D, adapters});
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-rewards-a2">
/* A2: izgled je izbor igrača; podrazumevani modeli ostaju originalni. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const D = window.KBMissionDirector.instance, KEY = 'kb_director_look_v1';
  const looks = [
    {id:'original',title:'Originalni izgled',color:null,shade:null,mission:null,description:'Prepoznatljiva odeća ekipe.'},
    {id:'supply',title:'Boja ekipe',color:'#d9ac55',shade:'#aa7d32',mission:'legacy.2d.supplies',description:'Zlatno-oker majica za završene Zalihe za ekipu.'},
    {id:'forest',title:'Šumska putanja',color:'#658b70',shade:'#45634c',mission:'legacy.2d.explore',description:'Zelena majica za Istraživača brda.'},
    {id:'signal',title:'Poslednji signal',color:'#7ebbc6',shade:'#507f91',mission:'legacy.3d.station',description:'Ledeno-plava majica za završetak stare 3D priče.'}
  ];
  let selected = 'original', blocked = false, durable = true, rawSeen, awards = {}, palette = null;
  const cache = new WeakMap();
  function validate(v) {
    if (!v || Object.getPrototypeOf(v) !== Object.prototype || v.version !== 1 ||
      Object.keys(v).some(k => !['kind','version','selected'].includes(k)) ||
      v.kind !== 'kb-director-look' || !looks.some(x => x.id === v.selected))
      throw Error('Nepoznat ili oštećen zapis izgleda.');
    return {kind:v.kind,version:1,selected:v.selected};
  }
  function refresh() {
    awards = D.serialize().profile.awards;
    const entry = looks.find(x => x.id === selected);
    palette = entry && (!entry.mission || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(awards,entry.mission)) ? entry : looks[0];
  }
  function reload() {
    try {
      rawSeen = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY);
      selected = rawSeen === null ? 'original' : validate(JSON.parse(rawSeen)).selected;
      blocked = false; durable = true;
    } catch (e) { selected = 'original'; blocked = true; durable = false; D.report('look-read',e); }
    refresh();
  }
  function select(id) {
    const look = looks.find(x => x.id === id);
    if (blocked || !look || look.mission && !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(awards,look.mission)) return false;
    try {
      const current = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY);
      if (current !== rawSeen) { reload(); return false; }
      const raw = JSON.stringify({kind:'kb-director-look',version:1,selected:id});
      window.localStorage.setItem(KEY,raw); rawSeen = raw; selected = id; durable = true; refresh(); return true;
    } catch (e) { durable = false; D.report('look-write',e); return false; }
  }
  function role(original, index) {
    if (!palette.color || index !== 0) return original;
    let variants = cache.get(original);
    if (!variants) { variants = new Map(); cache.set(original,variants); }
    if (!variants.has(palette.id)) variants.set(palette.id,Object.freeze({...original,
      shirt:palette.color,shirtShade:palette.shade,coat:palette.color}));
    return variants.get(palette.id);
  }
  reload();
  D.subscribe(refresh);
  window.addEventListener('storage',e => { if (e.key === KEY || e.key === null) reload(); });
  window.KBRewardsA2 = Object.freeze({key:KEY,validate,reload,select,role,
    get classicColor(){return palette.color;},
    get status(){return {selected:palette.id,requested:selected,blocked,durable};},
    catalog(){return looks.map(x => ({...x,unlocked:!x.mission || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(awards,x.mission)}));}
  });
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-board-model-a2">
/* A2: prikaz čita kopije napretka. Ne izvršava niti završava stare misije. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const descriptions = {
    'legacy.2d.supplies':{where:'Kalač brdo → Grobarsko',hook:'Pera je gladan. Ekipa čeka.',hint:'Sakupi čips, kolu, burek i mleko. Odnesi ih do Grobarskog.',unit:'predmeta',prerequisite:null},
    'legacy.2d.explore':{where:'Deset zona brda',hook:'Kraj je veći nego što deluje.',hint:'Posle zaliha obiđi svih deset zona. Svaka nova zona ostaje zabeležena.',unit:'zona',prerequisite:'legacy.2d.supplies'},
    'legacy.2d.descent':{where:'Vrh Kalač brda → Grobarsko',hook:'Ko poslednji stigne, plaća burek.',hint:'Posle istraživanja idi na vrh. Ulazak u zonu pokreće trku do Grobarskog.',unit:'spust',prerequisite:'legacy.2d.explore'},
    'legacy.3d.park':{where:'Njegoševa / Gostivarska',hook:'Perin telefon zvoni iz pogrešnog vremena.',hint:'Pokreni ili nastavi 3D priču. Prvi trag je Perina prekinuta poruka.',unit:'zadataka',prerequisite:null},
    'legacy.3d.power':{where:'Durmitorska',hook:'Bandere šalju SOS.',hint:'Priča se nastavlja posle parkića. Lazar očitava impuls prve bandere.',unit:'zadataka',prerequisite:'legacy.3d.park'},
    'legacy.3d.station':{where:'Ukleta meteo stanica',hook:'Ovog puta čuješ Perin pravi glas.',hint:'Prati trag posle Durmitorske. Na stanici će biti potrebna sva trojica.',unit:'zadataka',prerequisite:'legacy.3d.power'}
  };
  const taskText = [
    ['Preslušaj Perinu prekinutu poruku.','Pregledaj zapadnu klupu u parkiću.','Podigni razbijeni telefon na X stazama.','Nađi bateriju i poklopac u trnju. Kreći se tiho.','Lazar skenira telefon, Andrej čuva prilaz.','Preslušaj vraćeni snimak.','Dovrši četvrti ton u Gostivarskoj.','Pregledaj kutiju treće lampe, ka Durmitorskoj.'],
    ['Lazar očitava Morzeove impulse prve bandere.','Uporedi fazu na sledećoj banderi.','Potvrdi poslednji čvor žice.','Spoji tri označena kontakta u ormariću.','Izaberi tihi ili brzi prolaz kroz kapiju.','Pregledaj Perinu ugašenu baklju.'],
    ['Proveri zapis kod stanice i rasporedi ekipu.','Andrej odvlači senku, Pera drži svetlo, Lazar skenira.','Odluči šta ćete sa zapisom.']
  ];
  function rows(catalog,snapshot) {
    const state = snapshot.campaign, old = state.legacy, missions = state.missions;
    return catalog.map(d => {
      const meta = descriptions[d.id] || {where:d.location||'3D kraj',hook:d.summary||d.title,hint:d.stages[missions[d.id]?.stage||0]?.hint||'Prati cilj aktivne misije.',unit:'ciljeva',prerequisite:d.prerequisites[0]||null}, m = missions[d.id];
      const completed = m?.status === 'completed', prereq = meta.prerequisite && missions[meta.prerequisite]?.status !== 'completed' && (d.legacy || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(snapshot.profile.awards,meta.prerequisite));
      const stage = d.stages[Math.min(m?.stage || 0,d.stages.length-1)], target = stage.goals.reduce((n,g)=>n+g.target,0);
      const progress = completed ? target : stage.goals.reduce((n,g)=>n+Math.min(g.target,m?.counts[g.id]||0),0);
      let status = completed ? 'Završeno' : prereq ? 'Zaključano' : 'Dostupno', hint = meta.hint;
      if (!completed && !prereq && (progress > 0 || m?.status === 'active')) status = 'U toku';
      if (m?.status === 'paused') status = 'Pauzirano';
      if (m?.status === 'failed') status = 'Prekinuto';
      if (d.id === 'legacy.2d.supplies' && !completed && progress === 4) hint = 'Torba je puna. Odnesi zalihe do Grobarskog.';
      if (d.id === 'legacy.2d.descent' && old.classic?.raceRunning) {status='U toku';hint='Trka traje. Stigni do Grobarskog.';}
      if (d.engine === '3d' && d.legacy && old.beta && !old.beta.complete) {
        const index = ['legacy.3d.park','legacy.3d.power','legacy.3d.station'].indexOf(d.id);
        if (index === old.beta.chapter && !completed) {status='U toku';hint=taskText[index][old.beta.step] || meta.hint;}
      }
      if (prereq && !completed) hint = 'Prvo završi: '+(catalog.find(x=>x.id===meta.prerequisite)?.title||'prethodnu misiju')+'.';
      return {id:d.id,title:d.title,engine:d.engine,...meta,status,hint,progress,target,
        percent:target ? Math.round(progress/target*100) : 0,record:snapshot.profile.records[d.id]||null};
    });
  }
  function time(seconds) {return Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0 ? seconds.toFixed(1)+' s' : '—';}
  function consequences(flags) {
    const entries = [];
    if (typeof flags.babaTrust === 'boolean') entries.push({title:'Baba Rada',text:flags.babaTrust?'Njeno poverenje je stečeno.':'Njeno poverenje nije stečeno.'});
    if (typeof flags.keepEcho === 'boolean') entries.push({title:'Zapis sa stanice',text:flags.keepEcho?'Zapis je sačuvan.':'Zapis nije sačuvan.'});
    if(typeof flags.zapisPodeljen==='boolean')entries.push({title:'Vladin zapis',text:flags.zapisPodeljen?'Ekipa ima rezervnu kopiju.':'Zapis je ostao kod Andreja.'});
    if(flags.b1FalseEcho)entries.push({title:'Lažni odjek',text:'Pravi trag je pronađen naknadnom proverom.'});
    if(flags.b1RadaHelp)entries.push({title:'Četiri tona',text:'Baba Rada je pomogla ekipi.'});
    if(flags.b1PatrolNoticed)entries.push({title:'Svetlo bez izvora',text:'Signal je primetio ekipu.'});
    if(typeof flags.b2ArchiveKept==='boolean')entries.push({title:'Arhiva stanice',text:flags.b2ArchiveKept?'Dokaz je sačuvan; izlaz je ostao u mraku.':'Rasveta izlaza je obnovljena; arhiva je prepisana.'});
    if(flags.b2Blurred)entries.push({title:'Oštećeni negativ',text:'Slika je obnovljena pomoću lampe.'});
    if(flags.b2DarkRoute)entries.push({title:'Pregoreli osigurači',text:'Ekipa je prešla na ručno uzemljenje.'});
    if(flags.b2SignalEscaped)entries.push({title:'Nebo odgovara',text:'Deo signala je pobegao u kraj.'});
    return entries;
  }
  window.KBBoardModelA2 = Object.freeze({rows,time,consequences});
})();

<script id="kb-mission-board-a2">
/* A2: modalna tabla; događaji i postojeći tick, bez dodatne petlje. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const D = window.KBMissionDirector.instance, A = window.KBMissionDirector.adapters;
  const M = window.KBBoardModelA2, R = window.KBRewardsA2;
  const tabs = [['tasks','Zadaci'],['journal','Dnevnik'],['dossiers','Dosijei'],['rewards','Nagrade']];
  let root = null, content, footer, opened = false, view = 'tasks', filter = 'all';
  let release = null, unsubscribe = null, previousFocus = null, previousInert = false, queue = false;
  let background = [], message = '';
  const esc = x => String(x).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  function empty(title,text) {return '<div class="kbmd-empty"><h3>'+esc(title)+'</h3><p>'+esc(text)+'</p></div>';}
  function medal(n) {return ['Bez medalje','Bronza','Srebro','Zlato'][n] || 'Bez medalje';}
  function taskCards(snapshot) {
    const rows = M.rows(D.catalog,snapshot), done = rows.filter(x=>x.status==='Završeno').length;
    return (window.KBStoryExtensions?.menuHTML()||'')+'<div class="kbmd-summary"><div><strong>'+done+' / '+rows.length+'</strong> završenih misija</div><div class="kbmd-filters" aria-label="Pogon">'+
      [['all','Sve'],['2d','2D'],['3d','3D']].map(([id,label])=>'<button type="button" data-filter="'+id+'" data-focus="filter-'+id+'" aria-pressed="'+(filter===id)+'">'+label+'</button>').join('')+'</div></div><div class="kbmd-grid">'+
      rows.filter(x=>filter==='all'||x.engine===filter).map(x=>'<article class="kbmd-card"><div class="kbmd-card-head"><span class="kbmd-engine">'+x.engine.toUpperCase()+' / PRIČA</span><span class="kbmd-state '+(x.status==='Završeno'?'done':x.status==='Zaključano'?'locked':'')+'">'+esc(x.status)+'</span></div><h3>'+esc(x.title)+'</h3><p>'+esc(x.hook)+'</p><div class="kbmd-where">'+esc(x.where)+'</div><div class="kbmd-progress"><span>'+x.progress+' / '+x.target+' '+esc(x.unit)+'</span><span>'+x.percent+'%</span></div><progress value="'+x.progress+'" max="'+x.target+'" aria-label="'+esc(x.title)+' — napredak"></progress><p class="kbmd-hint">'+esc(x.status==='Završeno'?'Završetak je zabeležen u ovoj kampanji.':x.hint)+'</p>'+
      (x.record?'<div class="kbmd-record">Lični rekord: '+M.time(x.record.elapsed)+(x.record.medal?' · '+medal(x.record.medal):'')+'</div>':'')+'</article>').join('')+'</div>';
  }
  function journal(snapshot) {
    const consequences = M.consequences(snapshot.campaign.flags), log = snapshot.campaign.journal.slice().reverse();
    let html = '';
    if (consequences.length) html += '<section class="kbmd-choices"><h3 class="kbmd-section-title">Odluke koje ostaju</h3><div class="kbmd-grid">'+consequences.map(x=>'<article class="kbmd-card"><h3>'+esc(x.title)+'</h3><p>'+esc(x.text)+'</p></article>').join('')+'</div></section>';
    html += '<h3 class="kbmd-section-title">Trag noći</h3>';
    if (!log.length) return html+empty('Prvi trag tek dolazi.','Završeci, pronađeni dosijei i odluke pojaviće se ovde tokom igre.');
    return html+'<ol class="kbmd-journal">'+log.map(j=>{
      const date = new Date(j.at), valid = Number.isFinite(date.getTime());
      return '<li>'+(valid?'<time datetime="'+date.toISOString()+'">'+esc(date.toLocaleString('sr-Latn-RS'))+'</time>':'')+esc(j.text)+'</li>';
    }).join('')+'</ol>';
  }
  function dossiers(snapshot) {
    const entries = snapshot.campaign.dossiers;
    if (!entries.length) return empty('Još nema dosijea.','Tragovi pronađeni u 3D priči ostaju ovde. Sledeći trag potraži u zadacima.');
    return '<p class="kbmd-wardrobe-note">'+entries.length+' sačuvanih tragova. Otvori naslov da pročitaš zapis.</p>'+entries.map(d=>'<details class="kbmd-dossier" data-dossier="'+esc(d.id)+'"><summary data-focus="dossier-'+esc(d.id)+'">'+esc(d.title)+'</summary><p>'+esc(d.body)+'</p></details>').join('');
  }
  function rewards(snapshot) {
    const state=R.status, rows=M.rows(D.catalog,snapshot), earned=Object.keys(snapshot.profile.awards).length;
    return (window.KBStoryExtensions?.rewardsHTML(snapshot)||'')+'<div class="kbmd-summary"><div><strong>'+earned+'</strong> zabeleženih završetaka</div></div><p class="kbmd-wardrobe-note">Izaberi Andrejevu majicu za originalnu 2D igru i 3D svet. Sačuvani izgled važi i kada učitaš raniji snimak. Fudbalski dresovi ostaju klupski.</p><div class="kbmd-grid">'+R.catalog().map(x=>{
      const equipped=state.selected===x.id, need=x.mission?rows.find(r=>r.id===x.mission)?.title:'';
      return '<article class="kbmd-card kbmd-reward"><div class="kbmd-swatch" style="background:'+(x.color||'#d7ddd3')+'" aria-hidden="true">KB</div><h3>'+esc(x.title)+'</h3><p>'+esc(x.description)+'</p>'+
        (!x.unlocked?'<div class="kbmd-record">Otključava: '+esc(need||'završetak misije')+'</div>':'')+
        '<button type="button" data-look="'+x.id+'" data-focus="look-'+x.id+'" aria-pressed="'+equipped+'" '+(!x.unlocked||state.blocked?'disabled':'')+'>'+(equipped?'Izabrano':x.unlocked?'Obuci':'Zaključano')+'</button></article>';
    }).join('')+'</div>';
  }
  function render() {
    if (!opened) return;
    const snapshot=D.serialize(), scroll=content.scrollTop, focused=document.activeElement?.dataset?.focus;
    const details=new Set([...content.querySelectorAll('details[open]')].map(x=>x.dataset.dossier));
    content.innerHTML = view==='tasks'?taskCards(snapshot):view==='journal'?journal(snapshot):view==='dossiers'?dossiers(snapshot):rewards(snapshot);
    content.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','kbmd-tab-'+view);
    for (const element of content.querySelectorAll('details')) element.open=details.has(element.dataset.dossier);
    for (const tab of root.querySelectorAll('[data-view]')) {const active=tab.dataset.view===view;tab.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(active));tab.tabIndex=active?0:-1;}
    content.scrollTop=scroll;
    if (focused) [...root.querySelectorAll('[data-focus]')].find(x=>x.dataset.focus===focused)?.focus({preventScroll:true});
    const warning=D.status.blocked?'Snimak je iz novije verzije ili je oštećen. Nije prepisan.':
      R.status.blocked?'Sačuvani izgled nije čitljiv. Originalni izgled je aktivan.':
      !D.status.durable||!R.status.durable?'Čuvanje nije dostupno. Napravi izvoz snimaka.':'';
    footer.textContent=message||warning||'F2 / Esc: zatvori · Napredak ostaje na ovom uređaju.';
    footer.classList.toggle('kbmd-error',!!warning);
  }
  function schedule() {
    if (!opened||queue) return; queue=true;
    Promise.resolve().then(()=>{queue=false;if(opened)render();}).catch(e=>D.report('board-render',e));
  }
  function init() {
    if(root)return;
    root=document.createElement('dialog');root.id='kbMissionBoardA2';root.tabIndex=-1;
    root.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');root.setAttribute('role','dialog');root.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','kbmd-title');
    root.innerHTML='<header class="kbmd-top"><div><div class="kbmd-kicker">KALAČ BRDO / TVOJ TRAG U KRAJU</div><h2 id="kbmd-title">Noć ima još priče.</h2><p class="kbmd-sub">Zadaci, odluke i stvari koje nosiš dalje.</p></div><button type="button" class="kbmd-close" data-close aria-label="Zatvori tablu misija">Zatvori ×</button></header><nav class="kbmd-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Pregled misija">'+tabs.map(([id,label],i)=>'<button type="button" role="tab" id="kbmd-tab-'+id+'" data-view="'+id+'" aria-controls="kbmd-panel" aria-selected="'+(i===0)+'" tabindex="'+(i===0?'0':'-1')+'">'+label+'</button>').join('')+'</nav><section class="kbmd-content" id="kbmd-panel" role="tabpanel" tabindex="0"></section><footer class="kbmd-footer" role="status" aria-live="polite"></footer>';
    document.body.appendChild(root);content=root.querySelector('.kbmd-content');footer=root.querySelector('.kbmd-footer');
    root.addEventListener('click',e=>{
      const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b||b.disabled)return;
      if(b.hasAttribute('data-close'))close();
      else if(b.dataset.view){view=b.dataset.view;message='';content.scrollTop=0;render();}
      else if(b.dataset.filter){filter=b.dataset.filter;render();}
      else if(b.dataset.look){message=R.select(b.dataset.look)?'Izgled je sačuvan.':'Izgled nije sačuvan. Proveri prostor ili ponovo otvori tablu.';render();}
    });
    root.addEventListener('cancel',e=>{e.preventDefault();close();});
    root.addEventListener('close',()=>{if(opened&&!root.open)close();});
  }
  function open() {
    if(opened)return true;if(window.KBStoryExtensions?.modal)return false;
    const shell=document.getElementById('kb-shell'), inShell=shell&&!shell.hidden;
    if(inShell&&['loader','gate','intro'].includes(shell.dataset.view))return false;
    const mode=window.KBShell?.modules.bridge?.mode();
    if(!inShell&&['hunt','horror'].includes(mode))return false;
    if(document.querySelector('dialog[open]'))return false;
    init(); previousFocus=document.activeElement;previousInert=root.inert;message='';
    const host=window.KBBeta3D?.live?A.host('3d'):window.KBOriginal2D?.active?A.host('2d'):null;
    try {
      if(host) {if(typeof host.holdForDirector!=='function')return false;release=host.holdForDirector();}
      D.flush();R.reload();
      const settings=window.KBShell?.modules.data?.settings()||{};
      root.style.setProperty('--board-scale',String([100,110,125].includes(settings.text)?settings.text/100:1));
      root.classList.toggle('kbmd-contrast',!!settings.highContrast);
      root.classList.toggle('kbmd-still',!!settings.motion);
      root.dataset.quality=String(settings.quality??'auto');
      root.inert=false;opened=true;render();
      if(typeof root.showModal==='function')root.showModal();
      else {background=[...document.body.children].filter(x=>x!==root).map(x=>[x,x.inert]);for(const [x]of background)x.inert=true;root.setAttribute('open','');}
      unsubscribe=D.subscribe(schedule);root.querySelector('[data-close]').focus({preventScroll:true});return true;
    } catch(e) {D.report('board-open',e);close();return false;}
  }
  function close() {
    if(!opened&&!release)return;
    opened=false;
    if(unsubscribe){unsubscribe();unsubscribe=null;}
    if(root){if(root.open&&typeof root.close==='function')root.close();else root.removeAttribute('open');root.inert=previousInert;}
    for(const [element,inert] of background)element.inert=inert;background=[];
    const done=release;release=null;
    try{if(done)done();}catch(e){D.report('board-release',e);}
    if(previousFocus?.isConnected)previousFocus.focus({preventScroll:true});previousFocus=null;
  }
  function key(e) {
    if(!opened){
      if(e.type==='keydown'&&e.key==='F2'&&!e.repeat&&!e.ctrlKey&&!e.altKey&&!e.metaKey&&
        !/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(e.target?.tagName||'')&&!e.target?.isContentEditable){if(open()){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();}}
      return;
    }
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if(e.type==='keyup')return;
    if(e.key==='Escape'||e.key==='F2'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)close();return;}
    const tab=e.target.closest?.('[data-view]');
    if(tab&&['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Home','End'].includes(e.key)){
      e.preventDefault();const index=tabs.findIndex(x=>x[0]===view);
      view=tabs[e.key==='Home'?0:e.key==='End'?3:(index+(e.key==='ArrowLeft'?3:1))%4][0];content.scrollTop=0;message='';render();root.querySelector('[data-view="'+view+'"]').focus();return;
    }
    if(e.key==='Tab'){
      const nodes=[...root.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]),summary,[tabindex="0"]')].filter(x=>x.tabIndex>=0&&!x.hidden),first=nodes[0],last=nodes[nodes.length-1];
      if(e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===first||!root.contains(document.activeElement))){e.preventDefault();last?.focus();}
      else if(!e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===last||!root.contains(document.activeElement))){e.preventDefault();first?.focus();}
    }
  }
  // Registracija pre pogona sprečava da E, Space ili Esc probiju do igre.
  window.addEventListener('keydown',key,true);window.addEventListener('keyup',key,true);
  document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest?.('[data-kb-board]')){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();open();}},true);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',close);
  window.KBMissionBoardA2=Object.freeze({open,close,get isOpen(){return opened;}});
})();

<script id="kb-mission-pace">
/* Kraće deonice, bez nove petlje. Bliski ciljevi imaju proverenu direktnu prohodnost. */
(() => {'use strict';
 const dist=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.z-b.z),copy=p=>({x:p.x,z:p.z});
 function near(H,from,dx=12,dz=0,min=8,max=24){
  const origin=H.clearSpot(from,.8),angle=Math.atan2(dz,dx),desired=Math.min(max,Math.max(min,Math.hypot(dx,dz)));
  for(const r of [desired,Math.max(min,desired*.7),min])for(const turn of [0,.4,-.4,.85,-.85,1.5,-1.5,Math.PI]){
   const q=H.clearSpot({x:origin.x+Math.cos(angle+turn)*r,z:origin.z+Math.sin(angle+turn)*r},.8),d=dist(origin,q);
   if(Number.isFinite(q.x)&&Number.isFinite(q.z)&&d>=min-.1&&d<=max&&!H.collide(q.x,q.z,.65)&&H.lineClear(origin,q,.65))return copy(q);
  }
  // U potpuno zatvorenoj geometriji ostaje dostupna tačka, ne cilj kroz zid.
  return copy(origin);
 }
 function layout1(H){const base=H.clearSpot(H.parkCenter,.8),radio=near(H,base,12,3),first=near(H,radio,8,-6,7,12);let second=near(H,radio,-8,6,7,12),rada=near(H,radio,10,8,9,18);
  if(dist(first,second)>24||!H.lineClear(first,second,.65))second=copy(radio);
  if(dist(second,rada)>24||!H.lineClear(second,rada,.65))rada=copy(radio);
  const cross=near(H,rada,20,0);return [base,radio,[first,second],rada,cross,cross,cross];}
 function layout2(H){const base=H.clearSpot(H.locations.find(p=>p.n==='Ukleta meteo stanica')||H.parkCenter,.8),photo=near(H,base,10,4),negative=near(H,photo,-8,6,7,14);let power=near(H,photo,12,-3);
  if(dist(negative,power)>24||!H.lineClear(negative,power,.65))power=copy(photo);
  const a=near(H,power,10,3),b=near(H,a,-6,9),c=near(H,b,10,4);return [base,photo,negative,power,power,[a,b,c],c];}
 function extension(){for(const r of [window.KBB1Runtime,window.KBB2Runtime])if(r?.active)return {r,s:r.debug()};return null;}
 function target(H){const e=extension();return e?e.s.checkpoint?.mode==='story'&&!e.s.screen?e.s.target:null:H.task;}
 function blocked(H){const e=extension();return !H.paceAllowed()||!!e&&(!!e.s.screen||e.s.checkpoint?.mode!=='story'||(e.r===window.KBB1Runtime?e.s.stage===4:e.s.stage===5));}
 function travel(H){if(blocked(H))return false;const t=target(H),p=H.actors[H.active];if(!t||dist(p,t)<70)return false;const q=near(H,t,p.x-t.x,p.z-t.z,9,16);if(dist(q,t)<7)return false;const ok=H.paceMove(q,false);if(ok){H.b1Route(t);H.tip('Ekipa je stigla do prilaza. Zadatak nastavljaš ovde.',4);window.KBStoryExtensions?.checkpoint();}return ok;}
 function gather(H){if(blocked(H))return false;return H.paceMove(H.actors[H.active],true);}
 let panel=null,clock=1;
 function tick(dt){clock+=dt;if(clock<.25)return;clock=0;const H=window.KBMissionDirector?.adapters.host('3d');if(!H)return;
  if(!panel){panel=document.createElement('aside');panel.id='kbPacePanel';panel.hidden=true;panel.innerHTML='<div data-pace-info></div><button type="button" data-pace-travel>Pređi do prilaza</button><button type="button" data-pace-gather>Pozovi ekipu</button>';H.gm.appendChild(panel);panel.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-pace-travel]'))travel(H);else if(e.target.closest('[data-pace-gather]')){if(gather(H))H.tip('Ekipa je ponovo uz tebe.',3);}});}
  const t=target(H),p=H.actors[H.active],far=!!t&&dist(p,t)>=70,crew=H.actors.some((a,i)=>i!==H.active&&(!H.story.on||i!==2||H.cine?.peraFound)&&dist(a,p)>12);
  panel.hidden=blocked(H)||!far&&!crew;panel.querySelector('[data-pace-travel]').hidden=!far;panel.querySelector('[data-pace-gather]').hidden=!crew;
  if(!panel.hidden){const cfg=window.KBShell?.modules.data?.settings()||{};panel.style.setProperty('--pace-scale',String((cfg.text||100)/100));panel.classList.toggle('pace-contrast',!!cfg.highContrast);panel.querySelector('[data-pace-info]').textContent=far?'Cilj je '+Math.round(dist(p,t))+' m daleko. Možeš da skratiš put.':'Drugari su zaostali. Pozovi ih do sebe.';}
 }
 window.KBMissionPace=Object.freeze({near,layout1,layout2,travel,gather,tick,blocked,target});
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-b1-driver">
/* B1 kontroler: stvarni host prosleđuje mapu i fiziku; UI dobija samo kopije. */
(() => {'use strict';
 const ID='story.b1.glas',KEY='story.b1',copy=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)),dist=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.z-b.z);
 function create(D,H,notify=()=>{}){
  let cp=null,game=null,screen='',running=false,points=null,lastStage=-1,saveAt=0,result=null;
  let cached=D.serialize();D.subscribe(()=>{cached=D.serialize();});
  const state=()=>cached,record=()=>state().campaign.missions[ID];
  const fresh=(mode,stage=0)=>({version:1,layoutVersion:1,stage,mode,seed:(Date.now()%4294967295)>>>0,difficulty:0,risk:false,elapsed:0,alert:0,hold:0,visited:[],scores:[],position:null,game:null});
  function findPoints(){return window.KBMissionPace.layout1(H);}  function target(){if(cp?.mode==='story'&&(record()?.stage??cp.stage)===6)return {x:H.actors[H.active].x,z:H.actors[H.active].z};if(!points||!cp)return null;const stage=record()?.stage??cp.stage;return stage===2?points[2][cp.visited.includes(0)?1:0]:points[stage];}
  function save(persist=false){if(!cp||!running)return;cp.position=H.actors?.[H.active]?{x:H.actors[H.active].x,z:H.actors[H.active].z}:cp.position;cp.game=game?game.serialize():null;D.setModule(KEY,cp,persist);if(persist)D.flush();}
  function phase(){const m=record();if(!m||cp.mode!=='story')return;if(m.stage!==lastStage){lastStage=m.stage;cp.stage=m.stage;cp.elapsed=0;cp.alert=0;cp.hold=0;cp.visited=[];game=null;cp.game=null;const t=target();if(t)H.b1Route(t);if(m.stage===4)H.say('Lazar','Svetlo ide bez automobila. Kad priđe, ugasi lampu i miruj.',7);save(true);} }
  function snapshot(){const m=record(),t=target(),p=H.actors?.[H.active];return {running,screen,result:copy(result),checkpoint:copy(cp),game:game?.debug()||null,stage:m?.stage??0,status:m?.status||'',target:t?copy(t):null,distance:t&&p?dist(t,p):0,lit:!!cp&&cp.elapsed%8>=3.4&&cp.elapsed%8<6.6,flags:copy(state().campaign.flags)};}
  function emit(){notify(snapshot());}
  function launch(action){
   cached=D.serialize();
   if(D.status.blocked)throw Error('Snimak nije čitljiv. Sačuvaj rezervnu kopiju.');
   const practice=/^(radio|tones)\.([012])$/.exec(action);
   if(practice&&D.status.active)throw Error('Završi aktivno poglavlje pre slobodnog pokušaja.');
   if(!practice&&D.status.active&&D.status.active!==ID)throw Error('Drugi zadatak je aktivan.');
   if(!practice&&!D.available(ID,{time:'night'}).ok)throw Error('Prvo završi Frekvenciju sa uklete meteo stanice.');
   H.b1Enter();cached=D.serialize();const old=D.module(KEY);points=findPoints();lastStage=-1;result=null;game=null;
   if(practice){cp=fresh('practice',-1);cp.difficulty=+practice[2];cp.game={kind:practice[1]};screen='setup';}
   else{
    const resume=D.status.active===ID;
    if(!resume){cp=fresh('story');D.setModule(KEY,cp,true);if(!D.start(ID,{time:'night'}))throw Error('Poglavlje nije pokrenuto.');}
    else {D.resume();cp=old?.mode==='story'?old:fresh('story',record().stage);}
    const savedPosition=cp.position?copy(cp.position):null,savedGame=cp.stage===record().stage?cp.game:null,savedElapsed=cp.elapsed,savedAlert=cp.alert,savedHold=cp.hold,savedVisited=cp.visited;
    const sameStage=cp.stage===record().stage;phase();if(sameStage){cp.elapsed=savedElapsed;cp.alert=savedAlert;cp.hold=savedHold;cp.visited=savedVisited;}
    if(resume&&savedPosition)H.b1Place(savedPosition);else H.b1Place(points[0]);
    if(savedGame){game=savedGame.kind==='radio'?window.KBB1Games.createRadio():window.KBB1Games.createTones();game.restore(savedGame);screen='paused';}
    else screen=record().stage===0?'message':'';
   }
   if(cp.mode==='story'&&old?.mode==='story'&&old.layoutVersion!==1){const t=target();if(t)H.b1Place(window.KBMissionPace.near(H,t,10,0,8,14));if(cp.stage===4)cp.elapsed=Math.min(cp.elapsed,70);H.tip?.('Snimak je nastavljen na bližem prilazu. Napredak je sačuvan.',5);}
   cp.layoutVersion=1;
   running=true;H.clearInput();if(!practice)save(true);emit();return true;
  }
  function beginGame(kind,difficulty=0,risk=false){cp.difficulty=difficulty;cp.risk=!!risk;game=kind==='radio'?window.KBB1Games.createRadio():window.KBB1Games.createTones();game.start(null,{difficulty,seed:cp.seed,risk,focus:!!state().profile.unlocks['radio.focus']});screen='game';save(true);emit();}
  function interact(){if(!running||screen||cp.mode!=='story')return false;const m=record(),t=target();if(!m||m.status!=='active'||!t||dist(H.actors[H.active],t)>6)return false;
   if(m.stage===0)screen='message';else if(m.stage===1||m.stage===3)screen='setup';else if(m.stage===5){D.signal('b1.listen');screen='choice';}else if(m.stage===6){
    const score=Math.max(0,Math.round((cp.scores.length?cp.scores.reduce((n,x)=>n+x,0)/cp.scores.length:55)-(state().campaign.flags.b1PatrolNoticed?8:0)));
    D.signal('b1.finish',{score});H.archive('b1_verified_signal','Glas između dve ulice',state().campaign.flags.zapisPodeljen?'Ekipa ima kopiju Vladinog signala. Radio-fokus je otključan.':'Zapis je ostao kod Andreja. Radio-fokus je otključan.');
    screen='complete';result={kind:'chapter',score,status:'won'};save(true);
   }else return false;H.clearInput();emit();return true;
  }
  function action(a){if(!running)return false;
   if(screen==='game'&&game&&['angle','turn','cursor','note','confirm'].includes(a.type)){game.interact(null,a);return true;}
   if(a.type==='message'){D.signal('b1.message');screen='';phase();}
   else if(a.type==='begin'){const kind=cp.mode==='practice'?cp.game?.kind:record().stage===1?'radio':'tones';if(!['radio','tones'].includes(kind))return false;beginGame(kind,a.difficulty??cp.difficulty,!!a.risk);return true;}
   else if(a.type==='pause'){if(screen==='game')screen='paused';else if(screen==='paused')screen='game';}
   else if(a.type==='choice'){if(!D.choose('share_recording',a.option))return false;Object.assign(H.ensureCine().flags,{zapisPodeljen:state().campaign.flags.zapisPodeljen});screen='';phase();}
   else if(a.type==='result'){screen='';result=null;if(cp.mode==='practice'||record()?.status==='completed'){running=false;}else phase();}
   else if(a.type==='leave'){suspend();return true;}
   else if(screen==='game'&&game){game.interact(null,a);}
   save(false);emit();return true;
  }
  function finishGame(){const s=game.serialize();result={kind:s.kind,status:s.status,score:s.score};D.recordGame(s.kind,s.difficulty,s.score,s.elapsed);cp.scores.push(s.status==='won'?s.score:45);cp.scores=cp.scores.slice(-2);game=null;cp.game=null;
   if(cp.mode==='story'){if(s.status==='won')D.signal(s.kind==='radio'?'b1.radio':'b1.tones');else D.fail(s.kind==='radio'?'Lažni signal. Potraži dva tiha odjeka.':'Rada je dovršila pesmu. Pomoć je zabeležena.');phase();}
   screen='result';save(true);emit();
  }
  function tick(dt){if(!running||!Number.isFinite(dt)||dt<=0||dt>.25)return false;if(screen){
     if(screen==='game'&&game){game.update(null,dt);D.tick(dt,{engine:'3d'});if(game.debug().status!=='playing')finishGame();}
     saveAt+=dt;if(saveAt>=1){saveAt=0;save(false);}return true;
    }
    if(cp.mode!=='story'||record()?.status!=='active')return false;
    phase();cp.elapsed=Math.min(100000,cp.elapsed+dt);const m=record(),p=H.actors[H.active],t=target();
    if(m.stage===2){const index=cp.visited.includes(0)?1:0;if(dist(p,t)<5&&!H.torch&&(p.move||0)<.25)cp.hold+=dt;else cp.hold=0;
     if(cp.hold>=2&&!cp.visited.includes(index)){cp.visited.push(index);cp.hold=0;D.signal('b1.quiet',{id:'echo'+index});phase();H.b1Route(target());}}
    if(m.stage===4){const lit=cp.elapsed%8>=3.4&&cp.elapsed%8<6.6;cp.alert=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,cp.alert+(lit&&(H.torch||(p.move||0)>.35)?dt*.32:-dt*.13)));
      if(cp.alert>=1||cp.elapsed>100){D.fail('Svetlo vas je primetilo. Pera je sklonio ekipu, ali signal vas sada prepoznaje.');phase();}
      else if(dist(p,t)<5&&cp.elapsed>=8){D.signal('b1.cross');phase();}}
    saveAt+=dt;if(saveAt>=1){saveAt=0;save(false);}return false;
  }
  function suspend(){if(!running)return;save(true);if(cp?.mode==='story'&&D.status.active===ID)D.pause();running=false;screen='';game=null;H.clearInput();emit();}
  function resumePractice(){cached=D.serialize();const old=D.module(KEY);if(!old||old.mode!=='practice'||!old.game)return false;if(D.status.active)throw Error('Poglavlje je aktivno.');H.b1Enter();points=findPoints();cp=old;game=old.game.kind==='radio'?window.KBB1Games.createRadio():window.KBB1Games.createTones();game.restore(old.game);screen='paused';running=true;emit();return true;}
  return Object.freeze({launch,resumePractice,interact,action,tick,suspend,save,snapshot,get modal(){return running&&!!screen;},get running(){return running;}});
 }
 window.KBB1Driver=Object.freeze({create});
})();

</script>

 function draw(s){if(!panel||s.screen!=='game')return;const canvas=panel.querySelector('canvas');if(!canvas)return;const c=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!c)return;const w=canvas.width,h=canvas.height,v=s.game,muted='#789a91',gold='#edce84',colors=['#9cd5e4','#e4aa92','#c7df95','#cfb5ed'];c.clearRect(0,0,w,h);c.fillStyle='#0b1718';c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.font='16px system-ui';

 function key(e){if(!driver?.modal)return;const s=driver.snapshot();e.stopImmediatePropagation();if(e.type==='keyup'){held.delete(e.key);return;}
  if(e.key==='Tab'){const list=[...panel.querySelectorAll('button,input,select')].filter(x=>!x.disabled),i=list.indexOf(document.activeElement);if(i<0||e.shiftKey&&i===0||!e.shiftKey&&i===list.length-1){e.preventDefault();list[e.shiftKey?list.length-1:0]?.focus();}return;}
  if(/^(SELECT|INPUT)$/.test(e.target?.tagName||'')&&e.key!=='Escape')return;
  if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat){if(s.screen==='game'||s.screen==='paused')driver.action({type:'pause'});else{driver.suspend();window.KBShell?.open();}}return;}
  if(s.screen==='game'){
   if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','a','d'].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();held.add(e.key);}
   if(e.repeat)return;
   if(s.game.kind==='tones'&&/^[1-4]$/.test(e.key)){e.preventDefault();const lane=+e.key-1;tone(lane);driver.action({type:'note',lane});}
   if(s.game.kind==='radio'&&['e','E',' '].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();driver.action({type:'confirm'});}
  }else if(s.screen==='message'&&['e','E'].includes(e.key)&&!e.repeat){e.preventDefault();driver.action({type:'message'});}
 }
 window.addEventListener('keydown',key,true);window.addEventListener('keyup',key,true);

  for(const [kind,name]of [['radio','Radio-triangulacija'],['tones','Četiri tona']]){html+='<h3>'+name+'</h3>';for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const r=s.profile.records['game.'+kind+'.'+i];html+='<button type="button" style="margin:4px" data-b1-launch="'+kind+'.'+i+'" '+(active?'disabled':'')+'>'+names[i]+(r?' · '+r.score+'/100 · '+['—','Bronza','Srebro','Zlato'][r.medal]:'')+'</button>';}}

 }
 function paint(mesh){if(!driver?.running||driver.modal)return;const s=driver.snapshot();if(s.stage!==4)return;const p=s.target,y=H.height(p.x,p.z);for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++){mesh.box(p.x+i*3,y+1.4,p.z, .15,2.8,.15,'#4a5d60');mesh.box(p.x+i*3,y+2.8,p.z,.6,.14,.3,s.lit?'#ffdba0':'#4e686d',s.lit?4:0);}}
