<script id="kb-b2-driver">
/* B2 kontroler: jedan postojeći tick; H je provereni v2 host proširen u B1. */
(() => {'use strict';
 const ID='story.b2.negativ',KEY='story.b2',copy=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)),dist=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.z-b.z);
 function create(D,H,notify=()=>{}){
  let running=false,screen='',cp=null,game=null,result=null,points=null,lastStage=-1,holding=false,saveAt=0,cached=D.serialize();
  D.subscribe(()=>{cached=D.serialize();});const state=()=>cached,record=()=>cached.campaign.missions[ID];
  const fresh=(mode,kind='photo')=>({version:1,layoutVersion:1,mode,kind,stage:mode==='story'?0:-1,seed:Date.now()>>>0,difficulty:0,risk:false,elapsed:0,hold:0,grounds:0,mistakes:0,scores:[],position:null,game:null});
  function findPoints(){return window.KBMissionPace.layout2(H);}  const needGrounds=()=>state().campaign.flags.b2ArchiveKept||state().campaign.flags.b2DarkRoute?3:2;
  const stormLimit=()=>state().campaign.flags.b2DarkRoute?115:90;
  function target(){if(cp?.mode==='story'&&cp.stage===6)return {x:H.actors[H.active].x,z:H.actors[H.active].z};if(!cp||!points)return null;return cp.stage===5?points[5][Math.min(2,cp.grounds)]:points[Math.max(0,cp.stage)];}
  function save(persist=false){if(!running||!cp)return;const p=H.actors[H.active];cp.position={x:p.x,z:p.z};cp.game=game?game.serialize():null;D.setModule(KEY,cp,persist);if(persist)D.flush();}
  function phase(){const m=record();if(!m||cp.mode!=='story'||m.stage===lastStage)return;lastStage=m.stage;cp.stage=m.stage;cp.elapsed=0;cp.hold=0;cp.grounds=0;cp.mistakes=0;cp.game=null;game=null;holding=false;if(m.stage===1)cp.kind='photo';if(m.stage===3)cp.kind='circuit';const t=target();if(t)H.b1Route(t);if(m.stage===5)H.say('Lazar','Tri voda, jedan nalet. Drži uzemljenje, pa otpusti kad oznaka pozeleni.',7);}
  function snapshot(){const t=target(),p=H.actors[H.active];return {running,screen,checkpoint:copy(cp),game:game?.debug()||null,result:copy(result),stage:cp?.stage??0,status:record()?.status||'',target:t?copy(t):null,distance:t?dist(p,t):0,flags:copy(state().campaign.flags),holding,storm:cp?cp.elapsed%7>=5:false,needGrounds:needGrounds(),stormLimit:stormLimit()};}
  const emit=()=>notify(snapshot());
  const factory=kind=>kind==='photo'?window.KBB2Games.createPhoto():window.KBB2Games.createCircuit();
  function launch(action){cached=D.serialize();const practice=/^(photo|circuit)\.([012])$/.exec(action),resumePractice=action==='resume-practice';
   if(!practice&&!resumePractice&&action!=='story')throw Error('Nepoznat B2 sadržaj.');
   if(D.status.blocked)throw Error('Snimak nije čitljiv. Sačuvaj rezervnu kopiju.');
   if((practice||resumePractice)&&D.status.active)throw Error('Završi aktivno poglavlje pre slobodnog pokušaja.');
   if(action==='story'&&(D.status.active&&D.status.active!==ID||!D.available(ID,{time:'night'}).ok))throw Error('Prvo završi Glas između dve ulice.');
   if(resumePractice&&!(D.module(KEY)?.mode==='practice'&&D.module(KEY)?.game))return false;
   H.b1Enter();cached=D.serialize();const old=D.module(KEY);points=findPoints();lastStage=-1;result=null;game=null;holding=false;saveAt=0;
   if(practice){cp=fresh('practice',practice[1]);cp.difficulty=+practice[2];screen='setup';}
   else if(resumePractice){cp=old;game=factory(cp.kind);game.restore(cp.game);screen='paused';if(cp.position)H.b1Place(cp.position);}
   else{const resume=D.status.active===ID;if(resume){D.resume();cp=old?.mode==='story'?copy(old):fresh('story');}else{cp=fresh('story');if(!D.start(ID,{time:'night'}))throw Error('Poglavlje nije pokrenuto.');}
    const before=copy(cp),same=cp.stage===record().stage;phase();if(same){cp.elapsed=before.elapsed;cp.hold=before.hold;cp.grounds=before.grounds;cp.mistakes=before.mistakes;}
    if(resume&&before.position)H.b1Place(before.position);else H.b1Place(points[0]);
    if(same&&before.game){game=factory(before.kind);game.restore(before.game);screen='paused';}else screen=cp.stage===0?'message':'';
    if(target())H.b1Route(target());
   }
   if(cp.mode==='story'&&old?.mode==='story'&&old.layoutVersion!==1){const t=target();if(t)H.b1Place(window.KBMissionPace.near(H,t,10,0,8,14));if(cp.stage===5)cp.elapsed=Math.min(cp.elapsed,stormLimit()-30);H.tip?.('Snimak je nastavljen na bližem prilazu. Napredak je sačuvan.',5);}
   cp.layoutVersion=1;
   running=true;H.clearInput();save(true);emit();return true;
  }
  function finishGame(){const v=game.serialize();result={kind:v.kind,status:v.status,score:v.score};D.recordGame(v.kind,v.difficulty,v.score,v.elapsed);cp.scores.push(v.status==='won'?v.score:40);cp.scores=cp.scores.slice(-2);game=null;cp.game=null;
   if(cp.mode==='story'){if(v.status==='won')D.signal(v.kind==='photo'?'b2.photo':'b2.circuit');else D.fail(v.kind==='photo'?'Fotografije su oštećene. Pronađi negativ pod lampom.':'Osigurači su pregoreli. Preostaje ručno uzemljenje.');phase();}screen='result';save(true);emit();
  }
  function interact(){if(!running||screen)return false;if(cp.mode!=='story')return false;if(dist(H.actors[H.active],target())>6)return true;const m=record();
   if(m.stage===0)screen='message';else if(m.stage===1||m.stage===3)screen='setup';else if(m.stage===4){D.signal('b2.listen');screen='choice';}
   else if(m.stage===6){const score=Math.round(Math.max(0,(cp.scores.reduce((n,x)=>n+x,0)/(cp.scores.length||1))-(state().campaign.flags.b2SignalEscaped?8:0)));D.signal('b2.finish',{score});const body=(state().campaign.flags.b2ArchiveKept?'Arhiva je sačuvana.':'Izlaz je osvetljen; arhiva je prepisana.')+(state().campaign.flags.b2SignalEscaped?' Deo signala je pobegao u kraj.':'Signal je uzemljen.');H.archive('b2_negativ','Negativ koji pamti',body);D.addDossier({id:'b2_negativ',title:'Negativ koji pamti',body});result={kind:'chapter',status:'won',score};screen='complete';}
   H.clearInput();save(true);emit();return true;
  }
  function action(a){if(!running||!a)return false;
   if(screen==='game'&&game&&['aim','finder','shoot','rotate','test','off'].includes(a.type))return game.interact(null,a);
   if(a.type==='message'&&screen==='message'){D.signal('b2.message');phase();screen='';}
   else if(a.type==='begin'&&screen==='setup'){cp.difficulty=Number.isInteger(a.difficulty)?Math.max(0,Math.min(2,a.difficulty)):cp.difficulty;cp.risk=!!a.risk;game=factory(cp.kind);game.start(null,{seed:cp.seed,difficulty:cp.difficulty,risk:cp.risk,cell:!!state().profile.unlocks['camera.cell'],reserve:!!state().profile.unlocks['fuse.reserve'],steady:!!a.steady,assist:cp.mode==='story'&&state().campaign.flags.zapisPodeljen===true});screen='game';}
   else if(a.type==='pause'&&(screen==='game'||screen==='paused'))screen=screen==='game'?'paused':'game';
   else if(a.type==='choice'&&screen==='choice'){if(!D.choose('power_route',a.option))return false;H.ensureCine().flags.b2ArchiveKept=state().campaign.flags.b2ArchiveKept;phase();screen='';}
   else if(a.type==='result'&&(screen==='result'||screen==='complete')){screen='';result=null;if(cp.mode==='practice'||record()?.status==='completed')running=false;}
   else if(a.type==='leave'){suspend();return true;}
   else if(a.type==='ground-cancel'&&!screen&&cp.stage===5){holding=false;cp.hold=0;}
   else if(a.type==='ground'&&!screen&&cp.stage===5){if(a.down){if(dist(H.actors[H.active],target())>6)return false;holding=true;cp.hold=0;}else if(holding){holding=false;const lo=state().campaign.flags.babaTrust?.7:.9,hi=state().campaign.flags.b2ArchiveKept?1.55:1.85;if(cp.hold>=lo&&cp.hold<=hi&&cp.elapsed%7<5&&dist(H.actors[H.active],target())<=6){cp.grounds++;if(cp.grounds>=needGrounds()){D.signal('b2.storm');phase();}else H.b1Route(target());}else cp.mistakes=Math.min(100,cp.mistakes+1);cp.hold=0;}else return false;}
   else return false;save(true);emit();return true;
  }
  function tick(dt){if(!running||!Number.isFinite(dt)||dt<=0||dt>.25)return false;
   if(screen){if(screen==='game'&&game){game.update(null,dt);if(cp.mode==='story')D.tick(dt,{engine:'3d'});if(game.debug().status!=='playing')finishGame();}saveAt+=dt;if(saveAt>=1){saveAt=0;save(false);}return true;}
   if(cp.mode!=='story'||record()?.status!=='active')return false;phase();cp.elapsed=Math.min(100000,cp.elapsed+dt);const p=H.actors[H.active];
   if(cp.stage===2){if(dist(p,target())<=6&&H.torch&&(p.move||0)<.25)cp.hold=Math.min(4,cp.hold+dt);else cp.hold=0;if(cp.hold>=3){D.signal('b2.negative');phase();save(true);}}
   if(cp.stage===5){if(holding){if(dist(p,target())<=6&&(p.move||0)<.25)cp.hold=Math.min(4,cp.hold+dt);else{holding=false;cp.hold=0;}}if(cp.elapsed>stormLimit()||cp.mistakes>=4){holding=false;D.fail('Udar je prošao kroz antenu. Ekipa je bezbedna, ali deo signala je pobegao.');phase();save(true);}}
   saveAt+=dt;if(saveAt>=1){saveAt=0;save(false);}return false;
  }
  function suspend(){if(!running)return;if(holding){holding=false;cp.hold=0;}save(true);if(cp.mode==='story'&&D.status.active===ID)D.pause();running=false;screen='';game=null;H.clearInput();emit();}
  return Object.freeze({launch,interact,action,tick,suspend,save,snapshot,get running(){return running;},get modal(){return running&&!!screen;}});
 }
 window.KBB2Driver=Object.freeze({create});
})();

<script id="kb-b2-runtime">

(() => {'use strict';
 const D=window.KBMissionDirector.instance,A=window.KBMissionDirector.adapters,ID='story.b2.negativ';

 function act(a){const ok=driver?.action(a);if(ok&&['shoot','test'].includes(a.type))cue(a.type);return ok;}
 function endGround(){if(groundPointer!==null){groundPointer=null;act({type:'ground',down:false});}}
 function init(){if(panel)return;panel=document.createElement('section');panel.id='kbB2Panel';panel.hidden=true;panel.tabIndex=-1;panel.setAttribute('role','dialog');panel.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');panel.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','kbB2Title');hud=document.createElement('aside');hud.id='kbB2HUD';hud.hidden=true;H.gm.appendChild(panel);H.gm.appendChild(hud);

  panel.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{const button=e.target.closest('[data-dir]');if(button){dpad=button.dataset.dir;try{button.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(_){}e.preventDefault();return;}if(e.target.tagName!=='CANVAS'||driver.snapshot().game?.kind!=='photo')return;const v=driver.snapshot().game,r=e.target.getBoundingClientRect();drag={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,aim:v.aim,w:r.width,h:r.height};e.target.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);e.preventDefault();});

  if(s.screen==='message'){title='V · Negativ koji pamti';body='<p><b>Vlada:</b> „Na jučerašnjoj slici vidim sutrašnje jutro.   if(k==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();if(e.repeat)return;if(s.screen==='game'||s.screen==='paused')act({type:'pause'});else{driver.suspend();window.KBShell?.open();}return;}
  if(/^(INPUT|SELECT)$/.test(e.target?.tagName||''))return;

  else if(!e.repeat&&['t','x'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();act({type:k==='t'?'test':'off'});}

<script id="kb-2d-core-v7">/* Mali deterministički mehanizmi bez zavisnosti od DOM-a. */
(()=>{'use strict';
class FixedClock{constructor(hz=60,maxSteps=5){this.step=1/hz;this.maxSteps=maxSteps;this.acc=0;this.alpha=0;this.steps=0;}reset(){this.acc=this.alpha=this.steps=0;}advance(elapsed,tick){this.acc=Math.min(this.acc+Math.max(0,Math.min(.05,Number(elapsed)||0)),this.step*this.maxSteps);this.steps=0;while(this.acc+1e-10>=this.step&&this.steps<this.maxSteps){tick(this.step);this.acc-=this.step;this.steps++;}this.alpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,this.acc/this.step));return this.alpha;}}
class SpatialGrid{constructor(cell=256){this.cell=cell;this.buckets=new Map();}key(x,y){return (Math.floor(x/this.cell)+32768)*65536+Math.floor(y/this.cell)+32768;}rebuild(items,x='x',y='y'){for(const b of this.buckets.values())b.length=0;for(const a of items){const key=this.key(a[x],a[y]);let b=this.buckets.get(key);if(!b)this.buckets.set(key,b=[]);b.push(a);}this.x=x;this.y=y;}query(x0,y0,x1,y1,out=[]){out.length=0;const C=this.cell;for(let x=Math.floor(x0/C);x<=Math.floor(x1/C);x++)for(let y=Math.floor(y0/C);y<=Math.floor(y1/C);y++){const b=this.buckets.get((x+32768)*65536+y+32768);if(b)for(const a of b)if(a[this.x]>=x0&&a[this.x]<=x1&&a[this.y]>=y0&&a[this.y]<=y1)out.push(a);}return out;}}
class Pool{constructor(make,limit=128){this.make=make;this.limit=limit;this.free=[];}take(){return this.free.pop()||this.make();}release(item){if(this.free.length<this.limit)this.free.push(item);}}
function repellerDecision(random,assist=false){return random()<(assist?.8:.65);}
class PathDistance{
 constructor(paths,cell=128){this.cell=cell;this.segments=[];this.grid=new Map();for(const p of paths)for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++){const a=p[i-1],b=p[i],id=this.segments.length;this.segments.push([a,b]);for(let x=Math.floor(Math.min(a[0],b[0])/cell);x<=Math.floor(Math.max(a[0],b[0])/cell);x++)for(let y=Math.floor(Math.min(a[1],b[1])/cell);y<=Math.floor(Math.max(a[1],b[1])/cell);y++){const k=(x+32768)*65536+y+32768;let q=this.grid.get(k);if(!q)this.grid.set(k,q=[]);q.push(id);}}this.seen=new Uint32Array(this.segments.length);this.stamp=0;}
 distance(x,y){const C=this.cell,cx=Math.floor(x/C),cy=Math.floor(y/C),stamp=++this.stamp;let best=Infinity;const visit=id=>{if(this.seen[id]===stamp)return;this.seen[id]=stamp;const [a,b]=this.segments[id],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a[0])*dx+(y-a[1])*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));best=Math.min(best,Math.hypot(x-a[0]-t*dx,y-a[1]-t*dy));};for(let r=0;r<=3;r++){for(let i=-r;i<=r;i++)for(let j=-r;j<=r;j++){if(r&&Math.abs(i)!==r&&Math.abs(j)!==r)continue;const q=this.grid.get((cx+i+32768)*65536+cy+j+32768);if(q)for(const id of q)visit(id);}const edge=Math.min(x-(cx-r)*C,(cx+r+1)*C-x,y-(cy-r)*C,(cy+r+1)*C-y);if(best<=edge)return best;}for(let id=0;id<this.segments.length;id++)visit(id);return best;}
}
function nearestSample(x,y,points,lengths,limit,at,step=5){let best=Infinity,result=0;const max=Math.floor(lengths[limit]/step)*step;for(let i=1;i<=limit;i++){const a=points[i-1],b=points[i],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a[0])*dx+(y-a[1])*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1))),s=Math.floor((lengths[i-1]+u*(lengths[i]-lengths[i-1]))/step)*step;for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const candidate=Math.max(0,Math.min(max,s+k*step)),p=at(candidate,0),d=Math.hypot(p[0]-x,p[1]-y);if(d<best||d===best&&candidate<result){best=d;result=candidate;}}}return result;}
window.KB2DCore={FixedClock,SpatialGrid,Pool,repellerDecision,PathDistance,nearestSample};
})();
</script>

<!-- 2. O IGRI -->
<section id="about" class="sec"><div class="kb-chapter-num" aria-hidden="true">01 / 09</div><div class="wrap">
  <p class="eyebrow rv">O IGRI</p>
  <h2 class="rv">SVET BEZ GRANICA. PRIČE BEZ KRAJA.</h2>
  <p class="sub rv">Kalac Brdo je avanturistička open-world igra inspirisana lokalnim ulicama, šumskim putevima i skrivenim mestima. Igrač slobodno istražuje mapu, otkriva tajne, pronalazi tragove i posećuje lokacije sa sopstvenom pričom.</p>
  <div class="grid3 stg">
    <article class="card rv"><span class="mark">01</span><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-compass"/></svg><h3>SLOBODNO ISTRAŽIVANJE</h3><p>Kreći se mapom bez unapred određenog puta i sam izaberi sledeću avanturu.</p></article>
    <article class="card rv"><span class="mark">02</span><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-eye"/></svg><h3>SKRIVENE MISTERIJE</h3><p>Pronađi tajne prolaze, stare tragove i lokacije koje nisu odmah vidljive.</p></article>
    <article class="card rv"><span class="mark">03</span><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-tree"/></svg><h3>ŽIVI SVET</h3><p>Istražuj prirodu, šumske delove i različite zone u kojima se mogu pojaviti životinje.</p></article>
  </div>
</div></section>

    <p>Andrej Pejčić je učenik Elektrotehničke škole „Nikola Tesla“ u Nišu i kreator projekta Kalac Brdo. Pored interesovanja za razvoj igara i web dizajn, Andrejev veliki cilj je da postane profesionalni fudbaler. Projekat Kalac Brdo predstavlja spoj kreativnosti, lokalne inspiracije, upornosti i želje da se jedna poznata sredina pretvori u originalan digitalni svet.</p>
